title: Interactive Knowledge Map
definition: A visual representation of knowledge where nodes can be interacted with to explore relationships and details.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a digital map where each dot represents a piece of information. You can click on these dots to learn more and discover connections between different ideas.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: An interactive knowledge map is a graphical user interface that uses nodes to represent concepts and edges to represent relationships between these concepts. It allows users to explore, search, and filter the knowledge in the map.
difficulty_levels.expert: Interactive knowledge maps are a type of visualization technique that combines the benefits of human-computer interaction and information visualization. They can be used to support various cognitive tasks such as learning, problem-solving, and decision-making. Interactive knowledge maps have been studied in different domains such as education, organizational management, and scientific research. They can also be used to model complex systems and simulate their behavior.

extra_fields.insight: The interactive knowledge map is a tool that allows users to navigate and explore the relationships between concepts in a visual and intuitive way.
